cliExit: Runtime main prints only fixed safe message then os.Exit1 on Run error. OS exit closes descriptors; protected role parent-EOF behavior is separate lifecycle proof. Process exit is not library-level joined cleanup or retry evidence.

controls.meaning: Actual four signed sealed fixture children; canceled Session.Close retains exact Group and actual acquired lease; contender times out; explicit owned retry reaps and releases. Historical error with no group/lock still reports failure separately.

finding.recommendation: Typed safe concrete Session cleanup error with Close(context.Context) retry and fixed Error/Format; preserve cause safely. Wrap only actual unresolved resources or expose explicit pending ownership state, not merely any historical cleanup error. Keep service lease with unresolved owned runtime until retry/reaping is joined.
finding.distinction: The bootstrap Group.Done watcher retains Session until actual reaping and can release its bootstrap lock. This prevents claiming all resources are immediately abandoned; it does not provide caller-visible bounded cleanup retry authority.
finding.path: Run joins scalar runtime_cleanup_failed when Session.Close fails, without returning the exact Session retry handle. Bootstrap cleanup already returns a concrete Session result on failure.

leaseClose: BootstrapLock.Close delegates to os.File.Close, which Go1.27.2 marks closed and invalidates Sysfd even on returned close error. Never retry a raw descriptor number or assume this returned error means live lease ownership.
